key_idea: The figure must use exactly the 2 pieces: one pink long piece and one blue square.
steps: The pieces are a pink long piece and a blue square. The pink piece is as long as 2 blue squares.
Put the blue square right next to the end of the pink piece.
That makes figure B: pink on the left and blue on the right.

choice_feedback.A: This is a big pink square with no blue square. It is twice as big as the pink piece.
choice_feedback.C: This is only the pink piece. The blue square is missing.
choice_feedback.D: This has a green square, and the pink piece is missing.
choice_feedback.E: This has 2 blue squares, but we have only 1.
